indicator_name: Currency weights of the import-weighted NEER (previous year's import shares), percent
description: Веса валют в NEER по структуре импорта предыдущего года, %
methodology: Dated the year the weights are used in NEER_IMPORT_WEIGHTED (shares of the previous year's imports), from 1996 (1995 imports). Items BASKET.CURRENCY and COVERAGE_BASKET = share of the basket's imports from partners with a currency in the index. A year whose basket Comtrade converts only in part (below 5% of all goods imports: CONSUMER 2000) takes the last complete year's structure -- the item name gives the year of the structure (CONSUMER 2001: 1999).
